44 package reports · 179 recorded candidates · 18 source surfaces

The search has a boundary.

Exhaustive means every registered surface and query is accounted for—not every item on the internet.

The rights taxonomy

PUBLIC DOMAIN CC0
Store, display and offer the exact verified file for download.
OPEN LICENSE CONDITIONAL
Store or embed only while preserving the license, attribution and modification conditions.
AUTHORIZED EMBED
Use the rights-holder or platform player; never extract or redistribute the media.
QUOTE LINK
Quote only the narrow passage required and link to the canonical record.
LINK ONLY
Describe and link; do not copy page media or protected expression.
PERMISSION REQUIRED
Hold from reproduction until written permission covers the exact use.
FAIR USE REVIEW
Hold for fact-specific editorial and qualified-counsel review.
REJECTED
Retain the discovery record and the reason; do not publish the asset.

Source-surface registry

SF01 · museum objects and collection API

The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access

Query frame: package title; maker; garment type; archive; house; date

Rights gate: Only object records whose image is marked Public Domain/CC0.

Open registry surface ↗
SF02 · photographs, prints, film and books

Library of Congress Free to Use and Reuse: Fashion

Query frame: package title; role; fashion; garment; pattern; archive

Rights gate: Collection advisory plus exact item record; preserve creator and identifier.

Open registry surface ↗
SF03 · objects, archives, audio, video, datasets and IIIF

Smithsonian Open Access

Query frame: package title; fashion; dress; designer; labor; archive; CC0

Rights gate: Only exact digital assets carrying the CC0 designation; Usage Conditions Apply is not open.

Open registry surface ↗
SF04 · fashion collections, interpretation and video

Victoria and Albert Museum Fashion

Query frame: package title; designer; archive; craft; house; photography

Rights gate: Link and cite unless the exact item supplies a reusable license.

Open registry surface ↗
SF05 · finding aids, oral histories, curricula and exhibitions

Museum at FIT and SPARC

Query frame: package title; designer; patternmaker; stylist; publicist; oral history

Rights gate: Finding-aid metadata may be cited; media stays link-only unless separately licensed.

Open registry surface ↗
SF06 · aggregated European cultural heritage

Europeana

Query frame: package title; fashion; designer; garment; atelier; archive

Rights gate: The provider record and standardized item-level rights statement control.

Open registry surface ↗
SF07 · books, periodicals, film, audio and preserved sites

Internet Archive

Query frame: package title; fashion house; patternmaking; garment industry; designer

Rights gate: Availability is not permission; use only a clearly public-domain/open-license item.

Open registry surface ↗
SF08 · images, video, audio and structured categories

Wikimedia Commons

Query frame: package title; designer; fashion archive; garment; runway

Rights gate: Verify the exact file page, creator, source and license; observe attribution/share-alike.

Open registry surface ↗
SF09 · international IP education and records

WIPO Fashion and IP

Query frame: package title; fashion trademark; design; copyright; licensing

Rights gate: Link and quote narrowly; educational material is not legal advice or a media license.

Open registry surface ↗
SF10 · official U.S. trademark records and guidance

USPTO trademark and examination records

Query frame: named mark; owner; assignment; trade dress; status

Rights gate: Public record evidence; screenshots and legal conclusions require separate review.

Open registry surface ↗
SF11 · statutes, circulars and registration guidance

U.S. Copyright Office

Query frame: package title; photograph; useful article; work made for hire; transfer

Rights gate: Quote narrowly and link; guidance does not decide a particular dispute.

Open registry surface ↗
SF12 · public company filings, agreements and transactions

SEC EDGAR

Query frame: designer; fashion company; employment; license; archive; control

Rights gate: Quote narrowly from the exact filing and distinguish one agreement from industry practice.

Open registry surface ↗
SF13 · official labor compliance resources

U.S. Department of Labor garment resources

Query frame: garment labor; supply chain; wages; worker; contractor

Rights gate: Link and paraphrase; jurisdiction and worker status remain fact-specific.

Open registry surface ↗
SF14 · labor standards, research and project records

International Labour Organization

Query frame: garment work; supply chain; craft; gender; wage; purchasing practice

Rights gate: Link and summarize with geography and method intact.

Open registry surface ↗
SF15 · cultural heritage and traditional-knowledge resources

UNESCO Digital Library

Query frame: textile; craft; fashion; traditional knowledge; safeguarding

Rights gate: Link and summarize; community authority and item media require independent review.

Open registry surface ↗
SF16 · first-party histories, archives, reports and media

Official designer, house and corporate archives

Query frame: exact entity; archive; annual report; collection; oral history; terms

Rights gate: First-party publication proves neither independence nor reuse permission; record exact URL.

Exact official entity URL is recorded per candidate.

SF17 · collection APIs, educational interactives and open-source experiments

Official museum and university interactives

Query frame: fashion collection interactive; archive tool; color; timeline; metadata

Rights gate: Link unless source code and license authorize reuse; review privacy and accessibility.

Open registry surface ↗
SF18 · primary legal and entity records

Government statutes, courts and corporate registries

Query frame: exact jurisdiction; statute; company; case; asset; transaction

Rights gate: Quote narrowly; jurisdiction, currency and case posture must be explicit.

Open registry surface ↗
